author: Robyn
text: I've been using Garden Grit for quite some time and am truly impressed with how my garden looks now. Emma takes care of pruning my fruit trees and roses, mowing the lawn, weeding the flower beds, and planting new additions when needed. Her advice on plants and maintenance has clearly improved the health and appearance of my garden. The prices are fair considering the high quality of service. I highly recommend Garden Grit to anyone needing reliable and skilled gardening assistance.

author: Jane
text: Emma visited last week to repair my watering system and provide suggestions for additional plants. Emma is knowledgable, creative, helpful and reliable. Excellent rates, a great result and a stress free experience. Thoroughly recommend Garden Grit and looking forward to hiring again.
